relevance_note: Single case report of a GFAP variant carrier: "GFAP sequencing revealed a heterogeneous missense mutation point c.236G>A" in a 37-year-old man with adult-onset Alexander disease.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand (case report, no tables); JSON built with a short script from values I typed. The patient's parents were sequenced ("Whole-exome sequencing for him and his parents was completed"; Fig. 3 legend shows father and mother chromatograms) so they get rows as tested relatives, but the text never states their result, so they have no variant rows and inheritance is 'not reported'. Zygosity left 'not reported': the paper writes 'heterogeneous', not 'heterozygous'. No transcript printed. 'Exon 1' is not recorded as genomic coordinates. 'The laboratory tests were normal' is a whole-investigation normal finding; recorded as excluded 'abnormal laboratory tests' without anything more specific. 'His past medical history was normal' not recorded as a feature. 'The sensation was intact' recorded as excluded 'sensory impairment'. Fig. 1 legend mentions 'gadolinium enhancement image' as the imaging sequence without saying the lesion enhanced, so 'contrast enhancement on MRI' is 'not reported'. Age at diagnosis not stated. 'carotid 3'/'carotid 7' copied as printed (likely meaning cervical levels). No contradictions found.
